hunks.baseline: The deeper he went into enemy territory, the closer he got to Jeok Cheongang fighting the Blood-Sword Demon Lord, the stronger the enemies became.
hunks.sol: The deeper he pushed into the enemy ranks, the closer he came to Jeok Cheongang’s fight with the Blood-Sword Demon Lord, the stronger the enemies grew.

hunks.baseline: To cut down every enemy still surging toward him, he had to unleash everything he’d been given.
hunks.sol: To bring down every enemy still surging toward him, Jin Taekyung would have to unleash everything he had.

hunks.baseline: The instant the thought arose in his mind and took shape as Will—
hunks.sol: The thought became Will.

hunks.baseline: The dozens of weapons surrounding Jin Taekyung fell from the air.
hunks.sol: The dozens of weapons surrounding him fell from the air.

hunks.baseline: All except one spear, which had held more blood than any of the other blades and still hadn’t lost its gleam.
hunks.sol: All but one spear. It had drunk more blood than any of the other blades, yet its gleam had not faded.

hunks.baseline: White Flame, wrapped in Force, flared to life in the wavering space and shot forward.
hunks.sol: In the wavering space, White Flame blazed with Force and shot forward.

hunks.baseline: At the end of that fierce streak of light, which tore through a human wave numbering in the hundreds, stood one man.
hunks.sol: At the end of its fierce passage through a human wave numbering in the hundreds stood one man.

hunks.baseline: With a roar like the sky splitting apart, a figure was driven backward by the immense force carried in the spearhead.
hunks.sol: A roar split the air like the sky breaking open. The immense force behind the spearhead drove a figure backward.

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord had been rushing toward Jeok Cheongang, who was already drenched in blood.
hunks.sol: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord had been rushing at Jeok Cheongang, who was now drenched in blood. He bared his bloodstained teeth at Jin Taekyung, standing on a red path strewn with finely chopped flesh.

hunks.baseline: Now, he bared his bloodstained teeth at Jin Taekyung, standing in a red path where enemies had been chopped into tiny pieces of flesh.
